{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load and inspect data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm: only 'completed' orders are in the population
completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
print("Number of completed orders:", len(completed))

# Check revenue: string with commas
print("Sample revenue values:", df['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Convert revenue to float: remove commas and cast
completed['revenue_float'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (999999.99) in completed group
qa_mask = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99')
qa_in_completed = qa_mask & (df['status'] == 'completed')
print("QA orders in completed:", qa_in_completed.sum())

# Compute mean
mean_revenue = completed['revenue_float'].mean()
print("Mean revenue of completed orders:", mean_revenue)"}
